title: Agree to Disagree? A Meta-Evaluation of LLM Misgendering

bias_targets.methodology: Meta-evaluating probability-based evaluations (calculating the likelihood/perplexity of correct versus incorrect pronouns in masked templatic sentences) against generation-based evaluations (prompting models with context and assessing the correctness of generated pronouns using automatic heuristics and human annotation) using datasets like MISGENDERED, TANGO, and RUFF.
